temporaryAssignment.description: Who works the position instead of its default employee, until unassign-temporarily. Never its default employee.

kind.description: employee: an employee works the position.

employeeId.patternErrorMessage: must be kebab-case: lowercase letters and digits separated by single hyphens
employeeId.description: Id of the employee working the position, i.e. the name of its folder in .llmco/employees.

kind.description: directors: the people working on the repository, identified by git, work the position themselves, without an employee.

title: llmco position state
description: What happens to a position while the company runs, in .llmco/.state/positions/<position-id>.json. Written by llmco and ignored by git; absent while the position's default employee works it, or nobody if it is vacant.
